def init():
    exp_table = []
    log_table = []
    i = 0
    while i < 256:
        log_table.append(0)
        i = i + 1
    value = 1
    i = 0
    while i < 255:
        exp_table.append(value)
        log_table[value] = i
        doubled = value << 1
        if doubled & 256:
            doubled = doubled ^ 0x11b
        value = doubled ^ value
        i = i + 1
    i = 255
    while i < 510:
        exp_table.append(exp_table[i - 255])
        i = i + 1

    sbox = []
    i = 0
    while i < 256:
        if i == 0:
            inverse = 0
        else:
            inverse = exp_table[255 - log_table[i]]
        rotated1 = ((inverse << 1) | (inverse >> 7)) & 255
        rotated2 = ((inverse << 2) | (inverse >> 6)) & 255
        rotated3 = ((inverse << 3) | (inverse >> 5)) & 255
        rotated4 = ((inverse << 4) | (inverse >> 4)) & 255
        sbox.append(inverse ^ rotated1 ^ rotated2 ^ rotated3 ^ rotated4 ^ 0x63)
        i = i + 1

    return dict(sbox=sbox)


def step(state, inputs):
    sbox = state.get("sbox")
    state_value = inputs.get("state_in", 0) & ((1 << 128) - 1)
    key_value = inputs.get("round_key", 0) & ((1 << 128) - 1)
    final_round = inputs.get("final_round", 0)

    substituted = []
    i = 0
    while i < 16:
        shift = 120 - 8 * i
        byte_value = (state_value >> shift) & 255
        substituted.append(sbox[byte_value])
        i = i + 1

    shifted = []
    i = 0
    while i < 16:
        shifted.append(0)
        i = i + 1
    column = 0
    while column < 4:
        row = 0
        while row < 4:
            source_column = (column + row) % 4
            shifted[row + 4 * column] = substituted[row + 4 * source_column]
            row = row + 1
        column = column + 1

    if not bool(final_round):
        mixed = []
        column = 0
        while column < 4:
            a0 = shifted[4 * column]
            a1 = shifted[1 + 4 * column]
            a2 = shifted[2 + 4 * column]
            a3 = shifted[3 + 4 * column]

            x0 = a0 << 1
            if x0 & 256:
                x0 = x0 ^ 0x11b
            x1 = a1 << 1
            if x1 & 256:
                x1 = x1 ^ 0x11b
            x2 = a2 << 1
            if x2 & 256:
                x2 = x2 ^ 0x11b
            x3 = a3 << 1
            if x3 & 256:
                x3 = x3 ^ 0x11b

            mixed.append((x0 ^ x1 ^ a1 ^ a2 ^ a3) & 255)
            mixed.append((a0 ^ x1 ^ a2 ^ a3) & 255)
            mixed.append((a0 ^ a1 ^ x2 ^ a3) & 255)
            mixed.append((a0 ^ a1 ^ a2 ^ x3) & 255)
            column = column + 1
    else:
        mixed = shifted

    result = 0
    i = 0
    while i < 16:
        shift = 120 - 8 * i
        key_byte = (key_value >> shift) & 255
        result = result | ((mixed[i] ^ key_byte) << shift)
        i = i + 1

    outputs = dict(state_out=result & ((1 << 128) - 1))
    return state, outputs
